_doc: Reviewed provenance for literals in model-visible text (#671 layer 1). Read by mcp/test_prompt_provenance.mjs, which checks every row: categories are closed, ids must resolve, fields must be identifiers, placeholders must hold one, a quoted check must sit beside what it explains, and every row must still occur in the text. Never a way back in for genre, theme or lyric examples (#671 safeguard 3).
